name: kailasa-temple.mp4
title: Kailasa Temple: carved from one rock
caption:
📍Kailasa Temple, Cave 16, Ellora Caves, Maharashtra
🗓️ Carved around 760 CE under King Krishna I (Rashtrakuta dynasty)

1️⃣ Cut 3 deep trenches into the hill
2️⃣ Carve the block from the TOP down: roof, then walls, then floor
3️⃣ About 200,000 tonnes of stone removed with hammers and chisels
4️⃣ About 32 m tall: as high as a 10-storey building

One wrong strike and there was no undo.
UNESCO World Heritage Site (Ellora, 1983). Still standing after 1,200+ years.

 Follow for the next build.

title: ₹1 every second vs Ambani: how long?
caption:
If you earned ₹1 every second, how long until you're as rich as Mukesh Ambani? 🤯

Guess before Bittu reveals it 👀 (comment your guess first!)

₹1 a second = ₹86,400 a day = just over ₹3 crore a year.
Start the day the pyramids were built, 4,500 years ago, and today you'd have ₹14,200 crore.
Ambani has about ₹7 lakh crore (Forbes, Nov 2026). That's almost 50× more.

The answer: more than 2 lakh years. Humans hadn't even invented farming back then.
